job: Show verified institutional access to a life-science AI workspace without depicting a dangerous biological procedure or implying safety approval.
scene: People-free editorial pop-art laboratory desk. A closed sample rack and simple microscope sit behind a blank institutional access form. Two clear coloured lanes lead from the form to a neutral tablet with empty geometric panels, suggesting Standard and project-specific access without text.
mustNotShow: Pathogens, viruses, weapons or dangerous laboratory procedures
Readable text, letters, numbers or pseudo-text
Checkmarks, shields, padlocks or approval seals
Medical diagnosis, patient record or clinical result
Charts, performance claims or safety guarantees

style.authority: LAiDIES current adult editorial pop-art direction
style.palette: Navy and plum linework with cyan, pink, coral and yellow accents.
style.finish: Crisp adult editorial composition, halftone print texture, strong silhouette and clean negative space.

output.alt: An illustrated laboratory desk with a blank access form, sample rack and two separate safeguard lanes.
